[docs]class UnsavedChangesHandler(object):
    """
    An object which reports changes on any of its
    attributes to a 'save_status_method' (usually
    'Config.unsaved_changes').
    """
    def __init__(self, save_status_method):
        if save_status_method != None:
            self.save_status_method = save_status_method
    
    def __setattr__(self, name, value):
        object.__setattr__(self, name, value)
        if hasattr(self, "save_status_method"):
            self.save_status_method(self, name, value)



[docs]class LinearSegmentFunction:
    """
    Function consisting of linear segments which build a
    continuous line connecting certain control points.
    The function increases monotonically.
    """

[docs]    def load(self, control_points):
        """
        Loads the function from the control points, building
        the linear function segments between the control-points.
        
        Args:
            control_points: A list of (x, y)-point-tuples
                defining the control-points of the function
        """
        self.control_points = [control_points[0], control_points[-1]]
        self.func_segments = [self.calc_func_segment(self.control_points[0],
                                                     self.control_points[-1])]
        for point in control_points[1:len(control_points) - 1]:
            self.add_control_point(*point)
    


[docs]    def add_control_point(self, x, y):
        """
        Adds a control point at (x, y), updating the function.
        If the resulting function after inserting (x, y) would
        not be monotonically increasing, nothing will happen.
        """
        nr = self.get_segment_nr_from_x(x)
        if nr != None:
            self.control_points.insert(nr + 1,
                                       (x,
                                        max(self.control_points[nr][1] ,
                                        min(y, self.control_points[nr + 1][1]))))
            self.func_segments[nr] = self.calc_func_segment(self.control_points[nr],
                                                            self.control_points[nr + 1])
            self.func_segments.insert(nr + 1,
                                      self.calc_func_segment(self.control_points[nr + 1],
                                                             self.control_points[nr + 2]))
                


[docs]    def remove_control_point(self, nr):
        """
        Removes the 'nr'-th control point from the function.
        Attempting to delete the first or last control point
        will result in nothing happening, because they are
        necessary for the function to exist.
        """
        if nr != 0 and nr != len(self.control_points) - 1:
            self.control_points.pop(nr)
            del self.func_segments[nr - 1: nr + 1]
            self.func_segments.insert(nr - 1,
                                      self.calc_func_segment(self.control_points[nr - 1],
                                                             self.control_points[nr]))
        


[docs]    def move_control_point(self, nr, x, y):
        """
        Moves the 'nr'-th control point to the point (x, y).
        If "x > x of the next point", nothing will happen, to ensure
        a monotonic increase (Same for "y > y of next point).
        """
        if nr == len(self.control_points) - 1:
            point_left = self.control_points[nr - 1]
            self.control_points[nr] = (self.control_points[nr][0],
                                       max(y, point_left[1]))
            self.func_segments[nr - 1] = self.calc_func_segment(point_left,
                                                                self.control_points[nr])
        elif nr == 0:
            point_right = self.control_points[nr + 1]
            self.control_points[nr] = (self.control_points[nr][0],
                                       min(y, point_right[1]))
            self.func_segments[nr] = self.calc_func_segment(self.control_points[nr],
                                                            point_right)
            
        else:
            point_left = self.control_points[nr - 1]
            point_right = self.control_points[nr + 1]
            
            if point_left[0] < x < point_right[0]:
                self.control_points[nr] = (x,
                                           min(point_right[1],
                                           max(y, point_left[1])))
                self.func_segments[nr] = self.calc_func_segment(self.control_points[nr],
                                                                point_right)
                self.func_segments[nr - 1] = self.calc_func_segment(point_left,
                                                                    self.control_points[nr])
        return self.control_points[nr]
                        


[docs]    def calc_func_segment(self, point1, point2):
        """
        Solves the equation y=a*x+b using the
        two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) returns
        (a, b).
        """
        x1, y1 = point1
        x2, y2 = point2
        a = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1)
        b = y2 - x2 * a
        return a, b
            


[docs]    def get_y(self, x):
        """
        Calculates the functions y-value from x.
        """
        if x == 0:
            return 0
        else:
            seg_nr = self.get_segment_nr_from_x(x)
            if seg_nr != None:
                a, b = self.func_segments[seg_nr]
                y = a * x + b
                return y
    


[docs]    def get_x(self, y):
        """
        Calculates the functions x-value from y.
        """
        if y == 0:
            return 0
        else:
            seg_nr = self.get_segment_nr_from_y(y)
            if seg_nr != None:
                a, b = self.func_segments[seg_nr]
                x = (y - b) / a
                if x > self.control_points[seg_nr][0]:
                    return x
    


[docs]    def get_segment_nr_from_x(self, x):
        """
        Calculates the number of the function segment belonging
        to the x-coordinate 'x'.
        """
        for nr in xrange(len(self.control_points) - 1):
            if self.control_points[nr][0] <= x <= self.control_points[nr + 1][0]:
                return nr
                break
            


[docs]    def get_segment_nr_from_y(self, y):
        """
        Calculates the number of the function segment belonging
        to the y-coordinate 'y'.
        """
        for nr in xrange(len(self.control_points) - 1):
            if self.control_points[nr][1] <= y <= self.control_points[nr + 1][1]:
                return nr
                break



[docs]class Loco(UnsavedChangesHandler):
    """
    A model-train loco.
    """
    def __init__(self,
                 save_status_method,
                 functions=None,
                 speed_to_step_func=None,
                 function_sounds=None,
                 engine=None,
                 name="Unbenannte Lok",
                 speed_steps=128,
                 max_speed=100.0,
                 address=1,
                 protocol="N 1",
                 accel_duration=11.5,
                 decel_duration=8.5,
                 direction=True,
                 img_path=None,
                 sound_volume=0.8,):
        UnsavedChangesHandler.__init__(self, save_status_method)
        # it is not possible to set the default value for
        # the "functions"-parameter above, because it is
        # a list and will therefore contain pointers to the same objects
        # for all locos, resulting in the same functions for all locos
        if functions == None:
            self.functions = []
        else:
            self.functions = functions
        self.speed_steps = speed_steps
        if speed_to_step_func == None:
            self.speed_to_step_func = LinearSegmentFunction()
            self.speed_to_step_func.load([(0.0, 0.0), (100.0, 128.0)])
        else:
            self.speed_to_step_func = speed_to_step_func
        if function_sounds == None:
            self.function_sounds = []
        else:
            self.function_sounds = function_sounds
        self.name = name
        self.address = address
        self.protocol = protocol

        self.accel_duration = accel_duration
        self.decel_duration = decel_duration
        self.direction = direction
        self.img_path = img_path
        self.max_speed = max_speed
        self.speed = 0.0
        self.speed_step = 0.0
        self.last_speed_step = 0
        
        self.sound_volume = sound_volume
        self.engine = engine


[docs]    def get_srcp_status(self, bus):
        self.last_speed_step = int(self.speed_step)
        if len(self.functions) > 0:
            toggled = [False for i in range(max([function.nr + 1 for function in self.functions]))]
            for function in self.functions:
                if function.state:
                    toggled[function.nr] = True
            functions = " " + " ".join(str(int(val)) for val in toggled)
        else:
            functions = ""
        text = "SET " + str(bus) + " GL " + str(self.address) + " " \
                + str(int(self.direction)) + " " + str(int(self.speed_step)) \
                + " " + str(self.speed_steps) + functions + "\n"
        
        locked_print(text)
        return text
    
    # value between -1 and 1, -1 means acceleration


[docs]    def accelerate(self, value):
        if value < 0:
            self.speed = min(self.max_speed,
                             max(0,
                                 self.speed - value *
                                 (0.05 / self.accel_duration * self.max_speed)))
        else:
            self.speed = min(self.max_speed,
                             max(0, self.speed - value *
                                 (0.05 / self.decel_duration * self.max_speed)))
        return self.speed
        


[docs]    def toggle_direction(self):
        self.direction = not self.direction

[docs]class SoundFunction:
    """
    A Function consisting of 'SoundSegments',
    used to determine the sound to be played at
    a certain speed.
    """
    def __init__(self, segments):
        self.segments = segments
        

[docs]    def get_sound(self, x, sound_type):
        """
        Returns the sound of type 'sound_type'
        from the segment at position 'x'.
        """
        nr = self.get_segment_nr_from_x(x)
        if nr != None:
            return getattr(self.segments[nr], sound_type)
        


[docs]    def get_segment_nr_from_x(self, x):
        """
        Returns the number of the SoundSegment
        belonging to the x-coordinate 'x'.
        """
        if x == 0:
            return -1
        else:
            for nr, segment in enumerate(self.segments):
                if segment.start < x <= segment.end:
                    return nr
                    break



[docs]def create_sound_segment(engine_type, *args):
    """
    Returns a newly created 'SoundSegment'
    according to 'engine_type'.
    """
    if engine_type == EngineType.STEAM:
        return SteamSoundSegment(*args)
    elif engine_type == EngineType.DIESEL:
        return DieselSoundSegment(*args)

[docs]class DieselSoundSegment(SoundSegment):
    """
    A segment for Diesel-sound, specifying the sound to
    be played for different conditions.
    Case 1: engine is running at constant speed
        a) engine is under load -> 'load_sound'
        b) else -> 'idle_sound'
    Case 2: engine is accelerating -> 'accel_sound'
    Case 3: engine is decelerating -> 'decel_sound'
    """
    type = "diesel"
    attributes = {SegmentPosition.UPPER: ["start",
                                          "end",
                                          "load_sound",
                                          "accel_sound",
                                          "decel_sound"],
                  SegmentPosition.MIDDLE: ["start",
                                           "end",
                                           "load_sound",
                                           "idle_sound",
                                           "accel_sound",
                                           "decel_sound"]}
    position = SegmentPosition.MIDDLE
    
    def __init__(self,
                 save_status_method,
                 start,
                 end,
                 load_sound=None,
                 idle_sound=None,
                 accel_sound=None,
                 decel_sound=None):
        SoundSegment.__init__(self, save_status_method, start, end)
        self.load_sound = load_sound
        self.idle_sound = idle_sound
        self.accel_sound = accel_sound
        self.decel_sound = decel_sound
                

[docs]    def set_position(self, position):
        """
        Creates the 'idle_sound'-attribute if position
        is 'SegmentPosition.MIDDLE', erases it if position
        is 'SegmentPosition.UPPER' (upper DieselSegments
        can't have an 'idle_sound').
        """
        if position != self.position:
            if position == SegmentPosition.MIDDLE:
                self.idle_sound = None
                self.position = SegmentPosition.MIDDLE
            elif position == SegmentPosition.UPPER:
                del self.idle_sound
                self.position = SegmentPosition.UPPER

[docs]def create_engine(engine_type, *args):
    """
    Returns a newly created 'Engine'

    def __init__(self, locos=None, server=None, joystick=None, sound=None):
        if locos == None:
            self.locos = []
        else:
            self.locos = locos
        if server == None:
            self.server = Server(self.unsaved_changes)
        else:
            self.server = server
        if joystick == None:
            self.joystick = Joystick(self.unsaved_changes)
        else:
            self.joystick = joystick
        if sound == None:
            self.sound = Sound(self.unsaved_changes)
        else:
            self.sound = sound
        # loco that is currently configured
        self.active_loco = None
        
        try:
            f = open("last_file.json")
            self.last_file = json.load(f)["last_file"]
            f.close()
        except IOError:
            self.last_file = ""
            locked_print("Noch kein letzter Dateipfad gespeichert.")
            

[docs]    def get_utf8_bytestring(self, value):
        if isinstance(value, unicode):
            value = value.encode("utf-8")
        return value
            


[docs]    def add_file_to_zip(self, zip_file, file_path, dest=""):
        try:
            file_name = basename(file_path)
            if dest != "":
                file_name = dest + os_sep + file_name
            if file_name not in zip_file.namelist():
                zip_file.write(file_path, file_name)
        # error occurs if file_path is None (type of error varies on different platforms)
        except:
            locked_print("Ungültige Datei '" + str(file_path) + 
                         "' konnte nicht in Lok-Verzeichnis kopiert werden.")
            return None
        else:
            return file_name
        


[docs]    def add_files_to_zip(self,
                         zip_file,
                         config_object,
                         attribs,
                         dest=""):
        for attrib in attribs:
            if hasattr(config_object, attrib):
                file_path = getattr(config_object, attrib)
                file_name = self.add_file_to_zip(zip_file,
                                                 file_path,
                                                 dest)
                setattr(config_object, attrib, file_name)
        


[docs]    def save_loco(self, loco, dir_path):        
        file_path = dir_path + os_sep + loco.name + ".zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(file_path,
                             "w",
                             zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
                             True) as zip_file:
            save_status_method = self.new_unsaved_changes_method
            # remove any references to GObjects, as they are not copyable
            del self.new_unsaved_changes_method
            self.notice_unsaved_changes = False
            loco = self.create_loco(loco,
                                    ObjectWrapper,
                                    self.get_param_list_from_object,
                                    None)
            if loco.engine != None:
                if loco.engine.type == EngineType.STEAM:
                    for segment in loco.engine.sound_segments:
                        segment.stroke_sounds = [self.add_file_to_zip(zip_file,
                                                                      stroke_sound,
                                                                      "sound")
                                                 for stroke_sound in segment.stroke_sounds]
                    self.add_files_to_zip(zip_file, loco.engine, ["idle_sound",
                                                                  "cylinder_steam_sound"],
                                          "sound")
                    
                elif loco.engine.type == EngineType.DIESEL:
                    for segment in loco.engine.sound_segments:
                        self.add_files_to_zip(zip_file,
                                              segment,
                                              ["load_sound",
                                               "idle_sound",
                                               "accel_sound",
                                               "decel_sound"],
                                              "sound")
                    self.add_files_to_zip(zip_file,
                                          loco.engine,
                                          ["start_sound",
                                           "idle_sound",
                                           "quit_sound"],
                                          "sound")
                    
                for sound in loco.engine.event_sounds:
                    sound.file_path = self.add_file_to_zip(zip_file,
                                                           sound.file_path,
                                                           "sound")
                        
            for sound in loco.function_sounds:
                sound.file_path = self.add_file_to_zip(zip_file,
                                                       sound.file_path,
                                                       "sound")
            
            loco.img_path = self.add_file_to_zip(zip_file,
                                                 loco.img_path,
                                                 "image")
            # write loco-config file
            zip_file.writestr(loco.name + ".loco",
                              json.dumps(self.create_loco_dict(loco),
                                         indent=2))
            locked_print("Lok wurde gespeichert in", file_path)
            self.new_unsaved_changes_method = save_status_method
            self.notice_unsaved_changes = True
        


[docs]    def create_loco_dict(self, loco):
        loco_dict = self.get_param_dict(loco,
                                        self.loco_attributes)
        loco_dict["speed_control_points"] = loco.speed_to_step_func.control_points
        loco_dict["function_sounds"] = [self.get_param_dict(function_sound,
                                                            self.function_sound_attributes)
                                        for function_sound in loco.function_sounds]
        if loco.engine != None:
            engine_dict = self.get_param_dict(loco.engine,
                                              self.engine_attributes[loco.engine.type])
            if loco.engine.sound_segments != None:
                engine_dict["sound_segments"] = [self.get_param_dict(segment,
                                                                     self.segment_attributes[segment.type])
                                                 for segment in loco.engine.sound_segments]
            else:
                engine_dict["sound_segments"] = None
            if loco.engine.event_sounds != None:
                engine_dict["event_sounds"] = [self.get_param_dict(event_sound,
                                                                   self.event_sound_attributes)
                                                 for event_sound in loco.engine.event_sounds]
            else:
                engine_dict["event_sounds"] = None
            loco_dict["engine"] = engine_dict
        else:
            loco_dict["engine"] = None
        function_list = [self.get_param_dict(function,
                                             self.function_attributes)
                         for function in loco.functions]
        loco_dict["functions"] = function_list
        return loco_dict
        


[docs]    def save(self, file_path):
        Config = {"locos": [self.create_loco_dict(loco) for loco in self.locos],
                  "server": self.get_param_dict(self.server,
                                                self.server_attributes),
                  "joystick": self.get_param_dict(self.joystick,
                                                  self.joystick_attributes),
                  "sound": self.get_param_dict(self.sound,
                                               self.sound_attributes)}
        
        f = open(file_path, "w")
        json.dump(Config, f, indent=2)
        f.close()
            
        self.has_unsaved_changes = False
        self.save_opened_file(file_path)
        locked_print("Einstellungen wurden gespeichert in " + file_path)
        


[docs]    def get_param_dict(self, config_object, attribute_list):
        param_dict = {}
        for attrib in attribute_list:
            try:
                param_dict[attrib[0]] = getattr(config_object, attrib[0])
            # needed for objects where we don't know if they have a
            # certain attribute (e.g. sound_segments)
            except AttributeError:
                pass
        return param_dict
    
    # appends path_prefix to all attribs of config_object


[docs]    def set_absolute_path(self, path_prefix, config_object, attribs):
        for attrib in attribs:
            file_name = getattr(config_object, attrib)
            if file_name != None and exists(path_prefix + file_name):
                setattr(config_object, attrib, path_prefix + file_name)
            else:
                setattr(config_object, attrib, file_name)
    


[docs]    def load_loco(self, file_path):
        dir_path, file_name = split(file_path)
        loco_name, ending = file_name.split(".")
        if ending == "zip":
            dir_path += os_sep + loco_name + os_sep
            with zipfile.ZipFile(file_path, "r") as zip_file:
                zip_file.extractall(dir_path)
        else:
            dir_path += os_sep
            
        with open(dir_path + loco_name + ".loco") as loco_file:
            loco_dict = json.load(loco_file)
            loco = self.create_loco(loco_dict,
                                    DictWrapper,
                                    self.get_param_list_from_dict,
                                    self.unsaved_changes)
            if loco.engine != None:
                if loco.engine.type == EngineType.STEAM:
                    for segment in loco.engine.sound_segments:
                        segment.stroke_sounds = [dir_path + stroke_sound
                                                 for stroke_sound in segment.stroke_sounds
                                                 if stroke_sound != None]
                    self.set_absolute_path(dir_path,
                                           loco.engine,
                                           ["idle_sound",
                                            "cylinder_steam_sound"])
                    
                elif loco.engine.type == EngineType.DIESEL:
                    for segment in loco.engine.sound_segments:
                        self.set_absolute_path(dir_path,
                                               segment,
                                               ["load_sound",
                                                "idle_sound",
                                                "accel_sound",
                                                "decel_sound"])
                    self.set_absolute_path(dir_path,
                                           loco.engine,
                                           ["start_sound",
                                            "idle_sound",
                                            "quit_sound"])
                    
                for sound in loco.engine.event_sounds:
                    self.set_absolute_path(dir_path,
                                           sound,
                                           ["file_path"])
                    
            for sound in loco.function_sounds:
                self.set_absolute_path(dir_path,
                                       sound,
                                       ["file_path"])
                
            self.set_absolute_path(dir_path,
                                   loco,
                                   ["img_path"])
            return loco



[docs]    def create_loco(self, loco_obj, wrapper, get_param_list, unsaved_changes_method):
        functions = []
        for function_obj in wrapper.get(loco_obj, "functions"):
            # old file format has no attrib 'toggle_mode', but bool 'use_push_to_make'
            if not wrapper.has_key(function_obj, "toggle_mode"):
                if wrapper.get(function_obj, "use_push_to_make"):
                    wrapper.set(function_obj, "toggle_mode", ToggleMode.PUSH)
                else:
                    wrapper.set(function_obj, "toggle_mode", ToggleMode.SWITCH)
            functions.append(DecoderFunction(unsaved_changes_method,
                                      *get_param_list(function_obj, self.function_attributes)))
        speed_func = LinearSegmentFunction()
        if wrapper == DictWrapper:
            speed_func.load(map(tuple,
                                wrapper.get(loco_obj,
                                            "speed_control_points")))
        else:
            speed_func.load(wrapper.get(wrapper.get(loco_obj,
                                                    "speed_to_step_func"),
                                        "control_points"))
        if wrapper.has_key(loco_obj, "function_sounds"):
            function_sounds = [FunctionSound(unsaved_changes_method,
                                             *get_param_list(function_sound_obj,
                                                             self.function_sound_attributes))
                               for function_sound_obj in wrapper.get(loco_obj,
                                                                     "function_sounds")]
        else:
            function_sounds = None
        if  wrapper.has_key(loco_obj, "engine") \
        and wrapper.get(loco_obj, "engine") != None:
            engine_obj = wrapper.get(loco_obj, "engine")
            param_list = get_param_list(engine_obj,
                                        self.engine_attributes[wrapper.get(engine_obj,
                                                                           "type")])
            param_list.insert(1, unsaved_changes_method)
            if wrapper.get(engine_obj, "sound_segments") != None:
                try:
                    sound_segments = [create_sound_segment(wrapper.get(engine_obj,
                                                                       "type"),
                                                           unsaved_changes_method,
                                                           *get_param_list(segment_obj,
                                                                           self.segment_attributes[wrapper.get(engine_obj,
                                                                                                               "type")],
                                                                           True))
                                      for segment_obj in wrapper.get(engine_obj,
                                                                     "sound_segments")]
                except KeyError:
                    locked_print("Die Datei besitzt noch keine "
                                 "Geräusch-Informationen.")
                    sound_segments = None
            else:
                sound_segments = None
            param_list.append(sound_segments)
            if wrapper.has_key(engine_obj, "event_sounds"):
                if wrapper.get(engine_obj, "event_sounds") != None:
                    param_list.append([EventSound(unsaved_changes_method,
                                                  *get_param_list(event_sound_obj,
                                                                  self.event_sound_attributes))
                                       for event_sound_obj in wrapper.get(engine_obj,
                                                                          "event_sounds")])
            engine = create_engine(*param_list)
        else:
            engine = None
             
        return Loco(unsaved_changes_method,
                    functions,
                    speed_func,
                    function_sounds,
                    engine,
                    *get_param_list(loco_obj, self.loco_attributes))



[docs]    def load(self, file_path):
        f = open(file_path)
        Config = json.load(f)
        f.close()
        
        self.notice_unsaved_changes = False
        self.locos = [self.create_loco(loco_dict,
                                       DictWrapper,
                                       self.get_param_list_from_dict,
                                       self.unsaved_changes)
                      for loco_dict in Config["locos"]]
        self.server = Server(self.unsaved_changes,
                             *self.get_param_list_from_dict(Config["server"],
                                                            self.server_attributes))
        self.joystick = Joystick(self.unsaved_changes,
                                 *self.get_param_list_from_dict(Config["joystick"],
                                                                self.joystick_attributes))
        # due to a bug in previous 4.x.x-versions,
        # the sound was not saved in the config file -> KeyError
        try:
            self.sound = Sound(self.unsaved_changes,
                               *self.get_param_list_from_dict(Config["sound"],
                                                              self.sound_attributes))
        except KeyError:
            self.sound = Sound(self.unsaved_changes)
        self.active_loco = None
        
        self.has_unsaved_changes = False
        self.save_opened_file(file_path)
        locked_print("Einstellungen wurden geladen aus " + file_path)
        self.notice_unsaved_changes = True
    


[docs]    def get_param_list_from_dict(self, config_dict, attribute_list, ignore=False):
        param_list = []
        for attrib, standard_value in attribute_list:
            try:
                value = config_dict[attrib]
            except KeyError:
                param_list.append(standard_value)
                if not ignore:
                    locked_print("Dateiformat inkorrekt: Attribut",
                                 attrib,
                                 "ist nicht enthalten, es wurde der Standardwert",
                                 standard_value,
                                 "verwendet.")
            else:
                # convert all unicode-objects into
                # utf-8-bytestrings to avoid ascii-related problems
                param_list.append(self.get_utf8_bytestring(value))
        return param_list
    


[docs]    def save_opened_file(self, file_path):
        if self.last_file != file_path:
            f = open("last_file.json", "w")
            json.dump({"last_file": file_path}, f, indent=2)
            f.close()
            self.last_file = file_path
        self.opened_file = file_path
    


[docs]    def create_copy(self):
        server = Server(None,
                        *self.get_param_list_from_object(self.server,
                                                         self.server_attributes))
        joystick = Joystick(None,
                            *self.get_param_list_from_object(self.joystick,
                                                             self.joystick_attributes))
        sound = Sound(None,
                      *self.get_param_list_from_object(self.sound,
                                                       self.sound_attributes))
         
        locos = [self.create_loco(loco,
                                  ObjectWrapper,
                                  self.get_param_list_from_object,
                                  None)
                 for loco in self.locos]
        return Config(locos, server, joystick, sound)
        


[docs]    def get_param_list_from_object(self,
                                   obj,
                                   attribs,
                                   unused_ignore=False):
        param_list = []
        for attrib, standard_value in attribs:
            try:
                param_list.append(getattr(obj, attrib))
            except:
                param_list.append(standard_value)
        return param_list
    


[docs]    def unsaved_changes(self, obj, name, value):
        """
        To be called whenever an action changes the Config-object.
        Normally this is done by using 'UnsavedChangesHandler'.
        """
        if self.notice_unsaved_changes:
            locked_print("Attribute '" + name + "' of object '" +
                         str(obj) + "' has new value:", value)
            self.has_unsaved_changes = True
            # if method has been setup, call it
            if self.opened_file != None \
            and hasattr(self, "new_unsaved_changes_method"):
                self.new_unsaved_changes_method()
